name: mason
description: Recorded engineering decisions, change impact, and documentation audits for coding assistants. Useful from the first task, with optional architecture maps.
long_description: Mason retrieves lessons and constraints from .mason/decisions/, checks their freshness, and combines them with references, related tests, and Git change history. Audit documentation and review committed changes without setup. Add an optional feature/flow map for architecture navigation.

tools.name: mason_init
tools.description: Inspect this project now: returns documentation audit findings, committed-diff review findings, decision/map status, and a quickstart playbook. Read-only, deterministic, and usable without a map. Optional base selects the review comparison; evidence imports CI manifests with check outcomes, commit freshness, and links to changed files and accepted decisions. mode: map returns the full Map-Reduce build workflow. Repeat calls refresh findings even after setup.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

mode.description: Quickstart checks and setup guide, or an explicit architecture map build

base.description: Git ref for committed-diff review; defaults to an available main branch ref

evidence.description: Repository-local CI evidence manifests to include in the review. Imports Vitest JSON and SARIF without executing check commands.

tools.name: mason_complete_init
tools.description: Record completion of assistant instruction setup in .mason/project.json. Other tools work without this marker. Repeated calls preserve the original setup time and existing settings; pass confluenceConfigured only to change that setting.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

confluenceConfigured.description: Set the Confluence setup status; omit to preserve the existing value

tools.name: mason_set_confluence
tools.description: Configure Confluence credentials. Without `spaceKey`: validates credentials and returns available spaces for the assistant to relay. With `spaceKey`: persists to ~/.mason/config.json. Warn the user that the API token will be visible in chat history before they paste it.

spaceKey.description: Confluence space key. Omit on the first call to list spaces.

parentPageId.description: Optional parent page ID under which Mason's index page is created

tools.name: export_to_confluence
tools.description: Sync the concept map to Confluence as product-readable wiki pages: index page, one page per feature, and a changelog. Mason replaces managed page bodies, including manual edits. Requires mason_set_confluence.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

parentPageId.description: Override the configured parent page ID

featurePagePrefix.description: Prefix for each feature page title

tools.name: get_snapshot
tools.description: Return the optional feature-to-file architecture map with drift and trust evidence. If no map exists, returns exists:false plus project structure, Git signals, and test pairs. Decision capture, get_context, and get_impact still work. No initialization required.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Assemble task context: matching decisions with rationale, approval, owner, sources, last review, and freshness, plus related tests, file impact, and any available map entries. Proposals are suggestions; legacy records are unreviewed; accepted decisions are constraints subject to freshness. No initialization or map required. Pass task and optional files. map.status and diagnostics preserve missing or invalid knowledge. Impact covers up to three unique files, expanding directory anchors.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

task.description: The task, bug, or change request in natural language

files.description: Optional file paths already known to be involved (e.g. from a diff or stack trace). Entries containing them are boosted above pure text matches.

tools.name: generate_snapshot_batch
tools.description: Map step of the concept-map build. Returns one batch of source files (skeletons of every file in the batch plus a few deeper-read bodies for grounding) and a system prompt instructing you to derive features and flows for ONLY this batch. Call repeatedly with the returned `nextOffset` until it is null, calling `save_partial_snapshot` between calls.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

offset.description: 0-indexed file offset to start the batch at. Omit on the first call.

files.description: Scope the batch walk to this explicit file list (e.g. the drift set from mason_check_drift). Pass the same list on every batch call of one refresh run; reduce_snapshot then merges into the existing map instead of rebuilding.

tools.name: save_partial_snapshot
tools.description: Persist the partial concept map you derived for one batch. Call once per batch with the `batchId` from `generate_snapshot_batch`.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

tools.name: reduce_snapshot
tools.description: Reduce step of the concept-map build. Returns every partial snapshot plus a system prompt asking you to merge them into one project-wide map. After producing the unified map, call save_snapshot.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

tools.name: save_snapshot
tools.description: Save a concept-to-files map as a persistent project snapshot. Persists across conversations.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

features.description: Map of feature names to their implementing files

flows.description: Map of flow names to ordered file chains

removeFeatures.description: Feature names to delete from the existing map (renamed or removed features). Only meaningful on incremental saves.

removeFlows.description: Flow names to delete from the existing map. Only meaningful on incremental saves.

tools.name: save_decision
tools.description: Capture or revise a decision proposal with rationale, anchors, optional owner, sources, and a known actor. No setup or map required. Writes a local record and preserves content history. Changes reset acceptance to proposed; unchanged content does not re-verify or refresh it. Use review_decision for authorized acceptance or reaffirmation. A proposal cannot supersede an accepted record; review its replacement and retire the original separately.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

title.description: Short, specific headline — becomes the stable record id (max 80 chars)

body.description: The knowledge itself: what was tried/decided, why, and what to avoid (max 1500 chars)

files.description: Repo-relative files or directory prefixes; changes flag the decision for re-verification across retrieval, hooks, and review

id.description: Existing id to revise; unchanged content does not re-verify

supersedes.description: Id of a decision this one replaces

owner.description: Responsible person or team; null clears it. Required for acceptance.

sources.description: Known source references; omit to preserve, [] clears

actor.description: Known person or agent recording this revision; omit when unknown

force.description: Save even when a near-duplicate was detected

tools.name: review_decision
tools.description: Prepare a decision review: returns the full record and history, provenance, committed changes, local edits, bounded source/diff previews, and a reviewToken. Then record accept, reaffirm, or retire with that token, the authorized reviewer, and a reason. Acceptance requires owner, source, readable Git HEAD, and committed anchor changes. Changed records or code invalidate the token. Identities and approvals are recorded assertions for normal PR review, not authenticated proof.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

id.description: Decision id from get_context or save_decision

action.description: Prepare is read-only; other actions record an authorized review

reviewer.description: Actual reviewer, required for a verdict

note.description: Review rationale, required for a verdict

reviewToken.description: Token from preparation; rejects stale record or code revisions

tools.name: mason_check_drift
tools.description: Distinguishes committed drift, working-tree changes, and verification failures. Unrelated or map-only commits do not make the map stale. Check how far the concept map has drifted from HEAD. Deterministic (git + filesystem, no LLM). Returns stale features/flows with the changed files behind them, unmapped new files, ghost files, renames, and a recommendation: up-to-date, incremental, or full-rebuild.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

tools.name: verify_snapshot
tools.description: Spot-check the concept map's correctness: returns a sample of entries (never-verified and least-recently-verified first) with skeletons of their claimed files, for the assistant to judge whether the files implement what each entry claims. Report verdicts via save_verification.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

tools.name: save_verification
tools.description: Record verify_snapshot verdicts: ok entries are stamped verifiedAt and verifiedHash; failures surface in get_context, get_snapshot, and mason_check_drift until corrected.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

verdicts.description: Entry name → {ok: boolean, note?: string (required when ok is false)}

tools.name: get_impact
tools.description: Trace the impact of changing files: historical co-change partners, references, and related tests. Deterministic, read-only, and usable without initialization, saved decisions, or a concept map.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

files.description: File paths or names to analyze

tools.name: analyze_project
tools.description: Git history analysis: commit conventions, stale directories, frequently changed (hot) files.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

tools.name: full_analysis
tools.description: One-shot orientation for a project WITHOUT a concept map: git stats, project structure, curated code samples, and test-to-source mapping. On a mapped project, prefer get_snapshot.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

tools.name: get_code_samples
tools.description: Get previews (~60 lines) of representative source files: entry points, config, hot files, test examples, and one file per directory.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

count.description: Maximum number of files to sample
